note: Dynamic: {query} is replaced with the confirmed product-identity text at call time via .replace(), NOT str.format(). Manufacturer spec-sheet dimension/weight lookup -> the physical Product dimension fields (resale_listing_ai/adapters.py's measures_lookup()). A web-search-with-citations call, same seam family as retail_price.
instructions: Find the manufacturer's specification sheet or official product page for: "{query}". From it, report the product's UNPACKAGED (the item itself) and PACKAGED (shipping box / retail package) dimensions and weight. Convert every dimension to centimetres and every weight to kilograms yourself, reporting the converted numeric value only (e.g. inches -> cm, pounds -> kg). Report source_url as the page you took the figures from. Only report a figure that is actually stated on a reputable manufacturer or major-retailer spec sheet — if you cannot find a genuine spec sheet for this exact product, set match_found to false and leave packaged/unpackaged null. Never estimate, guess, or fill in typical dimensions for the category. If only one of packaged/unpackaged is published, report that one and leave the other null.
